text: dsh-tool-local-model 是面向 DSH Web composer 的本地推理服务器管理插件。它注册 local_model 工具和 /local-model 命令，并在 composer dock 提供本地模型切换控件。用户可查看服务器状态与模型列表、启动或停止指定服务器、切换默认服务器，并获得 provider/model 引用以供模型路由选择。服务器由 profile 配置命令、参数、目录和端口；插件通过本机模型列表接口等待就绪，适合希望在 DSH 会话中管理 Ollama、llama.cpp 等本地推理服务的用户，不要求 API key。

dsh-tool-local-model manages local inference servers from the DSH web composer. Its tool, slash command, and composer controls inspect models and start, stop, or toggle configured servers. It checks each server locally and returns model references for a separate model route. No API key is required.
想从 DSH 里启动或关闭本机的 Ollama 模型服务。
需要在聊天界面快速查看本地推理服务正在提供哪些模型。
I want to start, stop, or check my locally configured inference servers from a DSH conversation.
dsh-tool-local-model 的功能「本地服务器生命周期」：通过 local_model 工具或 /local-model 命令启动、停止和切换 profile 配置的推理服务器；启动后等待本机模型列表可用，并返回服务器状态。
dsh-tool-local-model 的功能「模型状态与引用查看」：查询正在响应或全部已配置的服务器，读取模型名称并生成 provider/model 引用，供用户在单独配置的模型路由中选择。

dsh-tool-local-model README · dsh-local-model：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that lets the model start, stop, and inspect local inference servers — Strata, Ollama, llama.cpp, or anything else that answers an OpenAI-compatible model listing.

The agent asks for a server by name and gets back `provider/model` references it can select on the model route that fronts that server. No shell script in the middle, no per-machine hardcoding in the plugin: the servers are deployment configuration.

dsh-tool-local-model README · dsh-local-model：```text
> 帮我把本地的 ollama 拉起来，用 qwen2.5:7b

local_model start ollama
→ ollama: answering on port 11434 - ollama-local/qwen2.5:7b

dsh-tool-local-model README · Install：Not on npm yet. Vendor it into a harness checkout or link it from a profile:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/miloye7711-dotcom/dsh-local-model.git
cd dsh-local-model
pnpm install
pnpm run build

Then mount the built package by absolute path, or `pnpm link` it into the harness that will load it.

A `file:` dependency copies the package into the profile's `node_modules`; after editing sources, rebuild and copy `lib/` plus `client/` there again, or reinstall the profile.

dsh-tool-local-model README · Configure：Declare the servers this composition may start. `command`, `args`, and `cwd` go to the subprocess provider verbatim — no shell, so anything shell-shaped has to be spelled out.

```yaml
- id: local-model
  name: 'dsh-tool-local-model'
  config:
    default: strata        # what the bare `toggle` and the composer chip act on

dsh-tool-local-model README · Configure：| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `command` | executable name or absolute path |
| `args` | arguments, passed verbatim |
| `cwd` | working directory for the child process |
| `env` | extra environment entries, merged onto the provider's environment |
| `port` | the port the server listens on |
| `provider` | route name in `provider/model` refs; defaults to the config key |
| `modelsPath` | HTTP path answering the model list; defaults to `/v1/models` |
dsh-tool-local-model README · Configure：An empty `servers` table is valid: the tool is registered with nothing to start.

dsh-tool-local-model README · Actions：| `action` | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `list` | only servers that are answering |
| `status` | every configured server, answering or not |
| `start` | spawn if down, then wait until the model listing answers; idempotent when already up; terminates the child if the budget runs out; `server: "all"` starts every configured server |
| `stop` | terminate, wait for exit — only for servers **this plugin** started; `server: "all"` stops every server it owns |
| `toggle` | flip one server: stop it when it answers, start it when it is down; without a name it acts on `default` |

dsh-tool-local-model README · Actions：Starting a server stops the others this plugin owns, because `exclusive` defaults to true: two local engines usually compete for the same device memory. Set `exclusive: false` to keep several resident at once.

Readiness is one HTTP `GET <modelsPath>`: a server counts as up when it lists at least one model. That rule works for OpenAI-compatible servers and for Ollama-shaped listings (`data[].id` or `models[].name`).

dsh-tool-local-model README · Slash command：`/local-model [status | list | start [server|all] | stop [server|all] | toggle [server] | diag <text>]` — the same actions from the composer. `diag` appends a timestamped line to `~/.dsh/local-model/client-diag.log`.

dsh-tool-local-model README · Composer control and shortcut：The client half registers two 11px chips in `conversation.composer.dock`: `本地模型` toggles the `default` server only, `▾` opens a 272px panel with `状态`, one `● name` / `○ name` chip per configured server, one `用 <provider/model>` button per advertised ref, and the last result text. The panel only exists while open, so the dock row keeps its normal width; status text also lands in the transcript through the host command output.

dsh-tool-local-model README · Composer control and shortcut：`Ctrl+Shift+L` (`Cmd+Shift+L` on macOS) runs the same toggle from anywhere in the page. Defaults are bound per platform profile in `SHORTCUT_DEFAULTS`, so rebinding goes through the harness shortcut settings.

dsh-tool-local-model README · What this plugin does not do：It owns process lifecycle, not routing. To actually send a model request to a server it started, add an LLM adapter route whose `baseURL` is that server's port — for example an `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` provider:

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai'
  config:
    providers:

`refs` in the result gives exactly the `provider/model` spelling to select there.
section: What this plugin does not do

text:
dsh-tool-local-model README · Design notes：- **No new capability seam.** This is a Consumer over the existing `subprocess` capability; a second service definition would have no second consumer.
- **Termination is process-tree-wide**, because it goes through the same subprocess provider the rest of the harness uses — a killed server leaves no orphan worker processes.
- **No KV-cache churn.** The tool description and parameter schema are fixed text; nothing here changes between turns.
- **Ownership is enforced, not assumed.** `stop` refuses a server that answers on the port but was started elsewhere, rather than killing a process the plugin did not create.

dsh-tool-local-model README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck   # strict, no emit
pnpm test            # 7 tests over a real ToolRuntime
pnpm run build       # lib/ + declarations

The subprocess provider is faked in tests at the seam's shape, so the shipping plugin body runs unmodified against a real `ToolRuntime` and a real HTTP listener.
